venue.title: A devnet prediction Window
venue.subtitle: The owner signs a call; operators keep the clock and prints moving; the programs decide the result.
venue.note: Trading uses test tUSDC on Solana devnet. The price path depends on each Window's policy. PreStocks catalogue reads are signed by Agari's attestor; Pyth, RedStone and Switchboard have their own verification paths.

nodes.title: Owner wallet
nodes.subtitle: Signs an order or bounded grant
nodes.detail: A normal order needs the owner's wallet signature. Tap trading uses a browser session key under an owner-approved vault grant. Ops never receives the wallet private key.
nodes.authority: Can authorize its own stake and withdraw its own funds.

nodes.title: Web ticket
nodes.subtitle: Window, side, size, quote
nodes.detail: The web app reads the selected Window and shows current cost, return and maximum loss before a buy. A displayed quote is not a fill.
nodes.authority: Displays and prepares an action; it does not settle a Window.

nodes.title: Solana adapter
nodes.subtitle: packages/markets
nodes.detail: The Solana integration package reads accounts, builds instructions, submits signed transactions and exposes indexed reads to the app and actors.
nodes.authority: Builds or sends only with a supplied signer or approved session key.

nodes.title: Events + Vault
nodes.subtitle: Anchor programs on devnet
nodes.detail: agari-events holds order escrow, matches the book, records verified prints and settles or voids. agari-vault holds Trading Balance funds and checks bounded grants.
nodes.authority: Program checks, account owners and signatures determine spend and payout.

nodes.title: Price sources
nodes.subtitle: Pyth · RedStone · Switchboard · PreStocks
nodes.detail: Each Window's registry policy selects its price source. PreStocks is an unsigned catalogue input; Agari signs its own attestation of that read.
nodes.authority: A source read alone is not a recorded or settled print.

nodes.title: Price relay
nodes.subtitle: Boundary fetch + signed package
nodes.detail: The ops price relay fetches the required boundary data and submits it through the source-specific recording instruction.
nodes.authority: Its role key can record eligible prints, not spend a user's collateral.

nodes.title: Roller · maker · settler
nodes.subtitle: List, quote, settle or void
nodes.detail: The roller lists scheduled Windows, the capped maker quotes their books, and the settler cranks permissionless resolution or expiry voids.
nodes.authority: These roles operate the venue, not the owner's wallet.

nodes.title: Program checks
nodes.subtitle: Exact policy + clock + book
nodes.detail: The on-chain program verifies print signatures and timing, locks the Window, settles against the closing print or voids when the conditions require it.
nodes.authority: The outcome is an on-chain state transition, not an indexer decision.

nodes.title: Chain accounts + logs
nodes.subtitle: Window, ledger, receipts
nodes.detail: Program accounts and confirmed transactions are the authoritative record of a Window and the owner's position.
nodes.authority: A transaction signature must be checked for its actual effect.

nodes.title: Indexer
nodes.subtitle: Backfill + subscribe + verify
nodes.detail: The indexer follows program logs and accounts, backfills missed slots and verifies rows before serving app reads.
nodes.authority: Read-only projection; it cannot change settlement.

nodes.title: Web read API
nodes.subtitle: Books, positions, proof
nodes.detail: The web routes return current market, wallet and proof views from indexed and chain-backed data.
nodes.authority: A stale or absent read should be labeled as such by the UI.

nodes.title: Portfolio + Proof
nodes.subtitle: Outcome and source receipt
nodes.detail: Portfolio shows open and settled positions; the proof feed opens recorded opening and closing prints with their source and transaction links.
nodes.authority: A page is a view of evidence, not a substitute for the chain receipt.

desk.title: A separate PreStocks desk
desk.subtitle: The owner controls the mandate and exit; a bounded operator chooses timing.
desk.note: This live-money path has been exercised on a Surfpool fork of Solana mainnet only. Production practice desks use paper balances and have no on-chain trade or record seal. The mainnet program deployment is pending.

nodes.title: Owner wallet
nodes.subtitle: Mandate, deposit, withdrawal
nodes.detail: The owner chooses allowed PreStocks names, weights, a cash sleeve and limits. Only the owner may change the mandate or withdraw to its own token accounts.
nodes.authority: Only the owner signs owner instructions and can withdraw.

nodes.title: Desk studio
nodes.subtitle: Draft and practice
nodes.detail: The browser keeps a draft. A message signature starts a paper practice desk; six checks and the full record are required before the Go live path is offered.
nodes.authority: A practice signature moves no funds.

nodes.title: Mainnet desk PDA
nodes.subtitle: USDC + PreStocks tokens
nodes.detail: On mainnet, the desk PDA would hold the owner's cash and token positions. The fork rehearsal used this program; no mainnet desk has been deployed yet.
nodes.authority: The program, not the runner, controls custody.

nodes.title: Owner exit
nodes.subtitle: Pause, withdraw, close
nodes.detail: The owner can pause the operator and withdraw. The operator cannot change limits, redirect withdrawals or take ownership.
nodes.authority: Withdrawal is owner-only and destination-checked.

nodes.title: PreStocks marks
nodes.subtitle: Catalogue + token price
nodes.detail: The runner reads the token price and PreStocks mark, including transfer-fee and conversion details. The catalogue is unsigned.
nodes.authority: A catalogue read does not independently authenticate its value.

nodes.title: Desk runner
nodes.subtitle: Hourly price, quote and timing check
nodes.detail: The runner reads prices and Jupiter quotes at the owner's size, asks a bounded timing question and records buy, sell, ask, wait or refusal decisions.
nodes.authority: May propose permitted operator actions; cannot withdraw.

nodes.title: Price attestor
nodes.subtitle: Fresh signed reference
nodes.detail: A separate ops key signs the price, mark and multiplier. The program verifies its signature and freshness before an operator buy or sell.
nodes.authority: The premium and output safeguards rely on keeping this key separate from the operator.

nodes.title: agari-desk checks
nodes.subtitle: Allowlist, caps, premium, output
nodes.detail: The program checks allowed names, per-action and daily caps, a fresh reference, premium ceiling, minimum output and exact token movements.
nodes.authority: Rejects an operator action that breaks the owner's on-chain limits.

nodes.title: Desk assets
nodes.subtitle: PDA token accounts
nodes.detail: The desk's USDC and PreStocks token accounts are the input and output of an allowed swap.
nodes.authority: The runner cannot transfer them to an arbitrary destination.

nodes.title: Jupiter route
nodes.subtitle: Swap by CPI
nodes.detail: Jupiter supplies a route. The program checks setup, account limits, receiving accounts and before/after balances around the CPI.
nodes.authority: A quote is only a proposal; verified token deltas establish execution.

nodes.title: Hash chain
nodes.subtitle: Decision record seal
nodes.detail: A live trade seals its decision in the same transaction. A live no-action checkpoint also advances the chain. The stored record can be replayed against the on-chain head.
nodes.authority: Practice has a local paper record but no chain seal.

nodes.title: Desk cockpit
nodes.subtitle: Value, activity, rules
nodes.detail: The UI reads the mandate, position value, decisions and record, while labeling practice separately from live status.
nodes.authority: A displayed paper balance is not a wallet or on-chain balance.

prints.title: Where a closing print comes from
prints.subtitle: A Window's policy selects one verification path at its exact boundary.
prints.note: The basket index is in points, not dollars. It uses one catalogue read for every member; a missing member voids rather than mixing observations. A Pyth valuation index for OpenAI and Anthropic is a separate, currently unentitled feed and does not settle the PreStocks token Window.

nodes.title: Pyth, RedStone or Switchboard
nodes.subtitle: Source-specific signed update
nodes.detail: The registry's price policy chooses a source. Pyth uses a pull update for the exact Window boundary; other policies use their own signed-package verification and timing rules.
nodes.authority: The program checks source proof, not just a server label.

nodes.title: Price relay
nodes.subtitle: Fetch boundary evidence
nodes.detail: The relay obtains the signed material for the required opening or closing second and submits a record instruction.
nodes.authority: It cannot substitute a latest display price for an exact boundary print.

nodes.title: On-chain verifier
nodes.subtitle: Signature + time + policy
nodes.detail: The source-specific instruction checks the registered policy and acceptable proof before storing the print.
nodes.authority: A failed verification leaves the Window without a usable print.

nodes.title: Recorded print
nodes.subtitle: Opening or closing value
nodes.detail: The program stores the accepted value with its boundary and source, ready for settlement and proof reads.
nodes.authority: Only the recorded print can decide the Window.

nodes.title: PreStocks catalogue
nodes.subtitle: Unsigned token prices
nodes.detail: The catalogue supplies token prices and marks. For a basket, Agari reads all members together and computes an equal-weight price-return index in points.
nodes.authority: The catalogue is not an independent signed oracle.

nodes.title: Agari attestor
nodes.subtitle: Signs the venue's read
nodes.detail: The venue signs the observed token or basket value and its boundary for the event program.
nodes.authority: This is Agari's attestation of a catalogue read, not a PreStocks signature.

nodes.title: On-chain verifier
nodes.subtitle: Attestor + boundary
nodes.detail: The program verifies the configured attestor and policy before it records the token or basket print.
nodes.authority: A missing basket member invalidates the sample; the Window must void instead of settling on a partial index.

nodes.title: Recorded print
nodes.subtitle: Token dollars or basket points
nodes.detail: The resulting print is stored in the same event venue used by other Windows, but units and source trust differ.
nodes.authority: The proof page must name PreStocks and show basket units as points.

nodes.title: Opening print
nodes.subtitle: Value at the first boundary
nodes.detail: A Window's opening print fixes the reference line; a listed pre-open call can rest before this boundary without filling early.
nodes.authority: The open is stored on chain.

nodes.title: Closing print
nodes.subtitle: Value at the lock boundary
nodes.detail: A valid closing print arrives through the Window's registered policy. An absent or invalid print can lead to a void rather than a guessed outcome.
nodes.authority: The close is checked before resolution.

nodes.title: Settle or void
nodes.subtitle: Permissionless program call
nodes.detail: Anyone may crank the eligible program instruction. The event program decides Up, Down or Void from recorded facts.
nodes.authority: The ops settler is a caller, not the outcome authority.

nodes.title: Proof page
nodes.subtitle: Source + transactions
nodes.detail: The app shows the settled Window's prints, source policy and recording transaction links.
nodes.authority: The page is a readable trail; program accounts and receipts remain the authority.
